Blizzard Delays World of Warcraft: Forever Name Reservations Amid Technical Issues

Launch Technical Difficulties

Blizzard Entertainment has delayed the character name reservation system for World of Warcraft: Forever due to unresolved technical errors. Originally intended to allow players to secure names across different rulesets prior to the November 4 launch, the feature has faced significant accessibility hurdles.

Player Impact

European players reported grayed-out 'Play' buttons on the Battle.net launcher, preventing access to the character creation tool. While some users have shared community-sourced workarounds, such as adjusting regional settings in the launcher, these methods do not guarantee functionality. Blizzard has confirmed the delay via the Battle.net client, though the root cause remains under investigation. The system was scheduled for a North American rollout today at 1pm PT/4pm ET.

How to Verify

Players are encouraged to monitor the official Battle.net client notifications for updates regarding status and availability: https://www.ign.com/articles/world-of-warcraft-forever-name-reservation-is-broken-ahead-of-launch.
